text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position and repeated stance","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its claim early and keeps reminding the reader what side it is on."},{"evidence":"three numbered reasons with separate paragraphs","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay groups ideas into a recognizable introduction, body, and conclusion with one main reason per body paragraph."},{"evidence":"sensor example tied to mother's accidents","quality":"supporting detail use","description":"The essay develops a point with a specific personal example rather than only making general claims."},{"evidence":"repeating reasons at the end","quality":"conclusion restatement","description":"The essay closes by summarizing its main points and reinforcing its position."},{"evidence":"mentions safety, fewer crashes, and injured people","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay explains its reasons with some elaboration instead of leaving them as brief unsupported assertions."}]}
